name: window_trim
description: Window surround (窗套): a decorative ring around a window opening — side jambs, header, sill. projection=0 sits in the wall plane (replaces flanking wall blocks), projection=1 hangs one block out of the face. The four ring corners can use a distinct corner_material (角件).
when_to_use: Around every window the style card wants a surround for (see details.depth.window_trim). Run AFTER arch_window.py: origin = bottom-left cell of the OPENING as seen from outside (same convention as arch_window).

origin.notes: bottom-left cell of the window opening, seen from outside

facing.notes: outward direction of the wall face

projection.notes: 0 = flush in the wall plane, 1 = sticks out of the face

material.notes: ring material from the style card

corner_material.notes: the 4 ring corners (角件); empty = same as ring

sill_material.notes: bottom row becomes this (slabs get type=bottom)
